Full job description

  • Own the PostgreSQL schema and its migrations.
  • Keep the service running on AWS, with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Write the tests that let the team deploy twice a day.

Cisco, Routing, Switching, BGP, OSPF, Firewall, Linux, LAN, WAN
